S25.heading: Responsive layout → Medium and expanded breakpoints
S25.quote: For larger screens with medium and expanded breakpoints, bottom sheets have a default max-width to prevent undesired layouts and awkward spacing. However, this can be overridden if needed.

S27.heading: Input text
S27.quote: In single-line fields, as the cursor reaches the right field edge, text longer than the input line automatically scrolls left.

S28.heading: Placement
S28.quote: If a menu is in a position to be cut off, it should automatically reposition to appear to the left, right, or above the element that generates it.

S32.heading: Touch and pointer target sizes
S32.quote: Touch targets are the parts of the screen that respond to user input, extending beyond the visual bounds of an element.
